race.comment: AIDA (12) ran an eye-catcher first-up over 1400m at Rosehill then went to Canterbury over 1550m last start and didn't quite finish off after racing just in behind the speed. Looks well in with 2kgs less than last time. Better for recent racing and is a big chance to open the account. PALM TREE (7) had a 37-day break before her game third over 1400m at Warwick Farm last time out. Lightly raced filly who should come on from that run. Draws the perfect gate so expect her to be right in the finish. MARKOS PORT (1) made it four minor placings from five starts when third in the same race as AIDA at Canterbury recently. Not terribly well in at the weights but he is very honest and will run the mile right out. ALL OVER HARRY (2) should be near his top now and looks best of the rest.
